address: calle Crosera, sestiere Dorsoduro 3778, Venice, 30123, Italy
bio: In the somewhat more secretive Venice, a cosy wine bar that serves modern Mediterranean-style cuisine based on seasonal local produce (the fish comes from the Rialto market); on the menu there are, however, meat dishes such as milk and honey guinea fowl leg with mashed potatoes and endive. 600 labels of natural wines from sustainable viticulture....
